answer: Make every agent earn a stake of real, verified work before it can transact at full weight: identities start with tiny limits and grow only through attested jobs peers can audit. A sybil swarm is like a tundra in winter, vast and empty, thousands of accounts with no history at all. The cheapest fake hits its nadir fast because it cannot show sustained work, while a real agent's reputation echoes through every job it completes. Cheap to create, costly to age: that asymmetry makes mass fakery uneconomical.
